subject: Re: JAX-RTM kickoff — gradient-based retrieval for assimilation
body: Decision from Monday's review: go to scale, ice-only. The pilot ships gradient-based retrieval for ice-cloud scenes in Q3; mixed-phase gets a scoped research track rather than blocking the pilot (the 34-of-40 result with failures cleanly attributable is exactly the evidence the collaboration needed). Compute: with Freya's ~3 GPU-min per retrieval, Jelena sized the July runs and the ask went to Ines for a vulcan slice — note the 06-22 to 06-24 vulcan maintenance just wrapped, so scheduling should be clean. Funding for the runs comes off the B-88 discretionary line as planned. Remaining for the window: Leilani cuts the v0.1 package with the sparse-checkout install path documented, Quentin finishes the solver-validation note, Maren lands the Corpus staging pipeline. Good quarter — differentiability sold itself. — Anders
